name: team_planning_set_position_funding
description: Set which budget lines an open position in a scenario of a Team Planning plan draws on, in place of the line team_planning_funding derives: for a position paid from another cost centre, or split across lines. Each draw names a budget_line_id the scenario holds and its share. The scenarios that follow inherit it. team_planning_clear_change with the position_id and the facet 'funding' goes back to the derived line. Refused on the baseline, which has no period to fund, for a position that isn't open in the scenario, and unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it.

scenario_id.description: The scenario. The baseline is refused.

draws.description: The lines it draws on, each named once. A lone draw may leave out its share; otherwise the shares add up to 1.

share.description: The part of the position it funds, a decimal above 0 and at most 1, such as "0.5".
